channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minnesota gains a new billion-dollar company
item.description: Pivot Bio relocates headquarters from California, choosing the Twin Cities over other Midwest cities.

item.title: Man who killed Minneapolis North star athlete Deshaun Hill given shorter sentence second time around
item.description: The North Side of Minneapolis was rocked by the killing of “D-Hill,” who was the Polars’ starting quarterback and played on the basketball team.

item.title: Volunteer archives Renee Good memorial site artifacts
item.description: What happens next depends on the family’s wishes.

item.title: Kirill Kaprizov sets franchise goal-scoring record in Wild’s 5-1 victory over Lightning
item.description: Marian Gaborik’s mark of 219 goals with Minnesota fell as the Wild avoided a three-game losing streak.

item.title: Explosions sound in the Iranian capital as war with US and Israel enters a fifth day
item.description: Explosions sounded in Iran's capital city Wednesday as its war with the U.S. and Israel entered a fifth day following earlier strikes on an Iranian nuclear site and retaliatory strikes by the Islamic Republic across the Gulf region.

item.title: Thomson Reuters criticized by some Minnesota employees over its ICE contract
item.description: Workers at the company’s Eagan campus pressed their concerns to executives, including over potential misuse of license plate data, during Twin Cities immigration surge.

item.title: Judge, U.S. Attorney spar at contempt hearing over immigration court violations
item.description: The hearing was called to determine whether a federal judge will hold the U.S. government in civil or criminal contempt.

item.title: At Senate hearing, Noem refuses to apologize for calling Pretti and Good domestic terrorists
item.description: The Homeland Security secretary’s comments come after their deaths have been widely debated by lawmakers, and at times have even put her at odds with other Trump administration officials.

item.title: Target tackles groceries as first swing to revive sales growth
item.description: After another sales slide in the holiday quarter, executives laid out a turnaround plan that will spend billions to update both merchandise and stores.

item.title: White Bear Lake woman identified as one of the soldiers killed as part of Iran military attacks
item.description: Sgt. 1st Class Nicole M. Amor was killed on March 1, in a drone attack in Kuwait along with five other soldiers.
